summary: Entity 553 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1964-07-06. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
